purpose: Development-only paired Ours/V2E event generation with matched controllable pixel response.

training_input_endpoint.source: same cached Genesis display PNGs at the archived 100 Hz timestamps
training_input_endpoint.conversion: OpenCV IMREAD_GRAYSCALE uint8 values represented as float32 [0,255]
training_input_endpoint.response_transfer: V2E-compatible lin_log with threshold=20 DN, shared parameter values; no claim of scene-linear HDR response
training_input_endpoint.cached_scene_linear_hdr: retained and hashed as rollout provenance; not used as Ours sensor input in this experiment

pixel_response.interpretation: ideal deterministic pixel response; zero mismatch/noise/refractory and infinite bandwidth

temporal_paths.ours: frozen GenesisPhysicsEventPlugin with cached depth, segmentation, camera pose, and articulated/object poses for geometric motion interpolation
temporal_paths.v2e: official V2E image-folder pipeline with the existing official SuperSloMo checkpoint
temporal_paths.shared: input grayscale endpoints, timestamps, lin_log transfer, thresholds, bandwidth/noise values, labels, and episode split

evaluation.reference: same existing Direct-HDR event files and query timestamps for both checkpoints
evaluation.reference_usage: development material only; reserve untouched episodes for formal R1 test

episode_split.purpose: minimum-cache endpoint-to-endpoint R1 development validation only
